statement: Akamai is adding about $1.7 billion to this year's capital spending to pre-buy components such as memory, on top of roughly $5.5 billion of build spend for the Anthropic capacity.
why: Buying memory in advance is what operators do when they expect components to be scarce or dearer later, so it is a read on chain tightness as well as on committed build.

impact.mechanism: Advance component purchases pull memory inventory forward into one buyer's hands, tightening what is available to other buyers while signalling firm forward demand.

evidence.excerpt: $1.7 billion to this year's capital spending to buy components such as memory in advance
Akamai expects to spend about $5.5 billion
expects to increase 2026 capex by approximately $1.7 billion for supply chain components and memory pre-purchases
